target_customer: Airlines, airports and government aviation organizations, plus pilots through a consumer ATC app
problem: Pilot and controller radio holds operational information that is not captured as structured, real-time data.
business_model: enterprise API and software subscription plus a consumer app (ATC.com)
product_category: aviation AI, ATC radio transcription and data network

founders.name: Eric Button
founders.background_notes: Former professional pilot with 2,200 flight hours per YC page.

founders.name: Kristian Gaylord
education: Columbia, Statistics and Computer Science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Held an FAA Private Pilot certificate and did embedded computer vision for satellites, and high-frequency trading in Rust, per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom receiver hardware network across 80 airports plus speech models tuned to noisy ATC radio, built by a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A growing audio collection network produces proprietary training data and hardware deployments are hard to replicate quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Searches found ramp and airfield safety vendors but none doing the same radio transcription; no incumbent action documented.

market_need_then: US air traffic control modernization drew large federal funding attention in 2025 and 2026, and pilot-run teams saw a data gap in radio communications.

branding.brand_signature: Consumer ATC app that reportedly detected the El Paso airspace shutdown within minutes (Feb 2026, per YC page news item)
branding.community_and_virality: Consumer ATC app gave public visibility; United Airlines Ventures backing covered by Flying magazine

brand_strength.rationale: Name is descriptive of aviation and radar, and press from Flying magazine and the El Paso episode gave visibility. No brand-specific evidence otherwise.

outcome_analysis: Enhanced Radar is active and raised a $7M round led by Initialized in May 2026 with United Airlines Ventures participating, more than a year after the Winter 2025 batch. Pilot founders with a technical CTO and a hardware network across 80 airports support the story. Earlier funding is only in aggregators.
notes: Company site headline says $12 million while the URL slug says $7 million; Initialized, Flying and Dealroom say $7M, so $7M is used. Dealroom dates the round June 3, 2026, Initialized May 13, 2026. VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in March 2025 (aggregator only, unverified, not recorded). The Initialized post is from the lead investor. Stage labelled seed is an assumption; sources do not state the stage. Competitor list empty: dated search found ramp-safety vendors (Assaia, Saab), which are adjacent not direct. Founded year 2024 not sourced; set from batch only, treat as approximate.
